prompt:
Act as an art director.

Task: Create a clear YouTube thumbnail concept.

Input context:
- VIDEO TOPIC: [VIDEO TOPIC]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- TITLE: [TITLE]
- FORMAT: [FORMAT]

Propose two distinct thumbnail concepts with focal subject, contrast, text hierarchy and safe cropping. Keep the promise aligned with the actual video. Define a small-size readability check and do not claim improved click-through without measurement.

Specify composition, lighting, framing, style, desired resolution and aspect ratio. Preserve authorised references and identify details requiring human review.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Tutorial thumbnail concept
Show one before/after process comparison with a short, accurate label. Keep the title and visual complementary instead of repeating a long sentence. Avoid fake results or exaggerated facial reactions that misrepresent the content. Review at small size and compare comprehension before testing any click-through hypothesis. No performance gain is established.
